title: Start, steer and stop live translation on a call in progress
summary: Switch translation on partway through a call, speak a translated line into it, ask for a summary, and switch it off, each with one REST command.
scenario: An agent realises mid-call that the customer would rather speak Spanish, and a supervisor wants a summary afterwards

folds: round 7 gap: live-call control over REST
evidence: tools/openapi/rest.json Calling.CallRequest variant calling.live_translate: params required action, a oneOf of Calling.LiveTranslateStartAction, LiveTranslateInjectAction, LiveTranslateSummarizeAction and LiveTranslateStopAction

tools/openapi/rest.json start requires from_lang, to_lang and direction (an array of SWML.Calling.TranscribeDirection, enum remote-caller|local-caller) and takes voices, filters, webhook, live_events, ai_summary, speech_engine (deepgram|google), speech_timeout, vad settings; inject requires message and direction (the same enum as a single string); summarize requires nothing and takes webhook and prompt
npm @signalwire/sdk 2.0.5 client.calling.liveTranslate sends the same bodies
